verdict.rationale: Working Copy has a documented 'Repository Agent' AI assistant that users can converse with to browse, search, read/modify files, and commit/pull/push — a genuine built-in task-delegation agent. However, evidence is limited to a single doc line with no detail on capability scope, limitations, or independent/hands-on corroboration, and other AI mentions are narrow (commit-message suggestions only). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of Repository Agent's scope/limits, independent or community hands-on validation, and clarity on how broadly it can act autonomously.
